brief:
Israeli forces conducted drone attacks on Gaza that left three Palestinians injured, according to Wafa news agency. Two Palestinians sustained wounds in a strike targeting a group in Al-Shati refugee camp, west of Gaza City, on Sunday morning, with one person critically hurt.

A third Palestinian was also injured in the separate drone operations, though additional details about the circumstances and location of that strike were not immediately available.
dek: Three Palestinians injured in Israeli drone attacks on Gaza Two Palestinians were injured, one critically, on Sunday morning after an Israeli drone targeted a group of Palestinians in Al-Shati refugee camp, west of Gaza City, Wafa reported.
title: Israeli drone strikes wound three Palestinians in Gaza
